ja161:1.1: Have no intimacy with a bad person,
ja161:1.2: The noble know the worth of the ignoble.
ja161:1.3: Eventually he does what is wicked,
ja161:2.1: But he of whom you know: He is like I,
ja161:2.2: Having virtue and wisdom and learning,
ja161:2.3: With him one should certainly be friendly,
ja161:2.4: Happy is the meeting with a good person.
